back_cover_blurb: Turn raw data into answers you can trust. This book teaches data analysis with Python and pandas, one small, clear step at a time, from your first table to complete, tested reports.

Every example is a real program, run on Python 3.12, 3.13, 3.14 and 3.15 before publication, with the exact output printed beneath it. The datasets are generated by a program in the book, so you get exactly the same numbers on your computer.

You'll learn to load spreadsheets, CSV, JSON and databases; clean messy data; filter, group, join and reshape tables; work with dates and text; draw honest charts; test whether a difference is real; write SQL; and check AI-generated analysis code. Then you'll put it all together in six projects: retail sales, a customer survey, an A/B test, a stock study, air quality and health, and a household budget.
Real stories of famous data mistakes show why each habit matters. Every chapter has exercises with tested, worked solutions. Basic Python helps, but no data experience is needed.
